title: Core Scientific lands AMD AI deal as bitcoin mining operation winds down
summary: The agreement accelerates Core Scientific’s pivot from bitcoin mining toward AI data centers, following the termination of its ASIC agreement with Block.

title: Binance makes fighting crypto crime more difficult, says new report
summary: The New York Times says a quiet change to Binance's compliance rules is forcing international law enforcement to navigate slow-moving government treaties to get user data.

title: Apple kept fake bitcoin wallet on App Store after $875,000 theft report, lawsuit alleges
summary: A lawsuit alleges Apple kept a fake bitcoin wallet app on its store after one user reported an $875,000 theft, leading to another user having roughly $840,000 stolen.

title: Bitcoin’s recent stability hasn't been enough to spark a broader altcoin rally
Bitcoin drops as South Korean stocks tumble, Senate shelves crypto Clarity Act
summary: BTC shed 2% as South Korea's Kospi plunged 11% and the U.S. Senate shelved the Clarity Act, leaving the market facing a pivotal Fed decision on Wednesday.
